# Landlord Cover Guide

> Free, ad-free reference for what landlord insurance costs in Australia: published costs by state, a calculator, what a landlord policy actually covers, and answers to the questions landlords ask. Figures carry the date and source they were read from. We are not paid by any insurer listed here.

Costs are dated and change. This site is general information about published prices, not advice and not a recommendation to use any particular insurer.

## Costs and coverage

- [What landlord insurance costs in Australia](https://henrylovemiller.github.io/landlord-cover-guide/): Overview of published landlord insurance costs across the states and what drives the differences.
- [Landlord insurance cost by state](https://henrylovemiller.github.io/landlord-cover-guide/cost.html): Published cost figures by state, with the source each figure was read from and the date it was read.
- [Landlord insurance calculator](https://henrylovemiller.github.io/landlord-cover-guide/calculator.html): Estimate what cover would cost for a given property and excess.
- [What landlord insurance covers](https://henrylovemiller.github.io/landlord-cover-guide/whats-covered.html): What a landlord policy covers — building versus contents, and the common exclusions.

## Questions and policy

- [Landlord insurance FAQ](https://henrylovemiller.github.io/landlord-cover-guide/faq.html): Answers to the questions landlords ask most: whether it is compulsory, average cost, which state is most expensive, what an unoccupied excess means, whether it is tax deductible, and whether raising the excess saves money.
